metadata.title: Bivariate vegetation density x elevation gain, Homestead Valley Service Area (CSA 14)
metadata.purpose: Single-layer bivariate overlay for the 'Where Do We Have the Greatest Ability to Intervene?' chapter. Each polygon carries BOTH a vegetation class and an elevation class and is painted with one colour from a 4x4 matrix, so dense-fuel/high-exposure coincidence is a colour a reader can point at rather than an inference from two stacked translucent fills.
metadata.source_vegetation: ndvi_work/NDVI_aoi.tif - Sentinel-2A L2A, 10 m, see homestead_ndvi_vegetation.geojson metadata for full provenance and the dry-season caveat
metadata.source_elevation: topo_work/DEM_1m_26910.tif - USGS 3DEP 1 m bare-earth lidar DEM, see homestead_elevation.geojson metadata for provenance
metadata.common_grid: the NDVI raster's own 10 m grid, EPSG:32610; the 1 m DEM was reprojected (EPSG:26910 -> EPSG:32610, different datums) and area-averaged onto it
metadata.extent: vegetated cells only (NDVI >= 0.41). Non-vegetated ground is not a vegetation class in the shipped vegetation layer either, so the low column of the matrix means 'sparse vegetation', not 'no vegetation'.
metadata.mmu_basis: identical to homestead_ndvi_vegetation.geojson - applied to isolated connected vegetation patches only, never to class-boundary slivers - so the bivariate layer and the vegetation layer cover exactly the same ground
metadata.vegetation_break_basis: identical to homestead_ndvi_vegetation.geojson, so the same four words mean the same four things in both chapters
metadata.elevation_break_basis: quartiles of the elevation distribution across the vegetated cells - each elevation class covers a quarter of the mapped area. Equal-width alternatives were measured and rejected: they put only 1-3% of the mapped area in the highest elevation class, which would make the high-fuel/high-elevation corner of the matrix - the cell this chapter is about - invisible. See bivariate_work/class_candidates.json.
metadata.palette: 4x4 matrix, bilinear sRGB interpolation between four hand-chosen corners; luminance falls monotonically along every row and column. See bivariate_work/02_palette.py and bivariate_palette.json.
metadata.vectorization_method: GDAL polygonize algorithm (rasterio.features.shapes), 4-connectivity, exact-clipped to the CSA 14 boundary, coordinates snapped to a shared 1e-08 deg grid (shapely.set_precision).
